review_reason: Adds sign handling but misses overflow.
Negative overflow bounds are handled incorrectly.
Restores bounds handling without complexity change.
Only checks whether input is non-empty.
Recursive search is correct for small inputs but not a complexity improvement.
Greedy frontier reduces correct reachability from O(n squared) to O(n).
Counts spaces and all prior words.
Single slicing rotation reduces correct rotation from O(nk) to O(n).
Sliding window reduces correct search from O(n squared) to O(n).
